sql: SELECT timestamp, _sample_interval AS weight, index1 AS agent, blob1 AS event, blob2 AS product, blob3 AS mode, blob4 AS phase, blob5 AS outcome, blob6 AS error, blob7 AS broker_code, blob8 AS val_quality, blob9 AS val_source, blob10 AS expo_quality, double1 AS ts, double2 AS latency_ms, double3 AS daily_pnl, double4 AS equity, double5 AS position, double6 AS other_exposure, double7 AS execution, double8 AS open_orders, double9 AS has_pnl, double10 AS has_equity, double11 AS val_price, double12 AS val_observed_at, double13 AS val_age_ms, double14 AS consolidated_exposure, double15 AS has_val_price, double16 AS has_val_observed, double17 AS has_val_age, double18 AS has_consolidated FROM dodash_paper_trading WHERE index1 = 'btc-usd-paper' AND blob1 = 'cycle.completed' AND double1 >= 1789833287000 AND double1 < 1790576984604 ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 10000
